## Key Takeaways


- Parsons received the 2026 Company Member of the Year award from SAME Huntsville Post for its strong community engagement and leadership.
- The company actively supports national security missions in Huntsville, with over 1,300 employees contributing to defense and infrastructure programs.
- Parsons has longstanding relationships with federal agencies, supplying missile defense and intelligence capabilities for more than 40 years.
- Recent local investments include new facilities for integration and support of advanced programs, reflecting ongoing commitment to the area.


On October 21, the Society of American Military Engineers (SAME) Huntsville Post named Parsons its 2026 Company Member of the Year in the Large Business category, recognizing our sustained affiliation with the Post, leadership, young-member development and mentorship, community outreach, and sponsorship.


SAME Huntsville Post President presenting the award to Richard Heitkamp, Senior Vice President of Defense & Security Facilities; Jai Spivey, Senior Vice President of Federal Contracts; and Brian Clemons, Vice President of Engineering Services and Missile Defense PMO Director.


Our Huntsville presence is about more than where we work. It’s an investment in the people, partnerships, and engineering community behind some of the nation’s most important defense and space missions. With more than 1,300 employees in the Huntsville area, we support multiple federal agencies and programs while contributing our expertise, leadership, and time to the local engineering community.


### A Presence Built Around the Mission


For decades, our presence has grown alongside the region’s national security missions. We’ve supported missile defense, intelligence, engineering, technology integration, and federal infrastructure programs at Redstone Arsenal and across the broader Huntsville defense community.


#### **Missile Defense And Intelligence**


Missile defense is a cornerstone of that experience. We’ve supported the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and its predecessors for more than 40 years with systems engineering, integration, modeling and simulation, and technical support. From[MDA’s TEAMS programs](https://www.parsons.com/project/weapons-missile-systems-engineering/) toto today’s TEAMS-Next, we support the nation’s integrated Missile Defense System.


In 2026, we were awarded a position on the[$14 billion COMET multiple-award contract supporting the Missile & Space Intelligence Center](https://www.parsons.com/2026/08/parsons-awarded-position-on-14b-billion-comet-missile-and-space-intelligence-effort/) and its mission partners. This work brings together our intelligence, cyber, missile defense, space, and systems engineering capabilities.


#### **Federal Infrastructure**


Our relationship with the[U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Engineering and Support Center, Huntsville](https://www.parsons.com/2023/02/parsons-wins-position-on-675m-contract-supporting-usace-electronic-security-systems/) spans decades of infrastructure support. In 2023, we earned a position on a[$160 million contract](https://www.parsons.com/2023/03/parsons-wins-position-on-160m-u-s-army-corps-of-engineers-contract/) for military construction planning, programming, and management, our third consecutive five-year planning and programming contract with the Huntsville Center.


Most recently, we were selected as Owner’s Advisor for the new[U.S. Space Command headquarters at Redstone Arsenal](https://www.parsons.com/2026/09/parsons-awarded-85m-agreement-to-deliver-new-u-s-space-command-headquarters/) , extending that experience to one of the region’s most significant new infrastructure programs.


#### **Local Investment To Support Growing Missions**


We’ve expanded our local facilities to support these evolving missions:


- **2018:** We opened a[25,000-square-foot integration facility](https://www.parsons.com/2018/09/parsons-expands-technical-services-capacity-huntsville-al/) for software and hardware integration serving defense, intelligence, and infrastructure customers.
- **2025:** We opened a[27,000-square-foot Redstone Gateway facility](https://www.parsons.com/2025/09/parsons-expands-huntsville-footprint-with-opening-of-new-redstone-gateway-facility/) just outside Redstone Arsenal to support advanced programs, secure collaboration, and development, testing, and deployment.


Together, these programs and investments reflect how we’re evolving with Huntsville’s defense, space, intelligence, and infrastructure missions.


### Investing In The Community Behind The Mission


Current and retired Parsons employees have served on the SAME Huntsville Post Board of Directors, including as Post presidents. We’ve also supported the Post’s Scholarship Golf Tournament and Industry Days, helping fund scholarships for future engineering leaders in the area and supporting forums focused on innovation, technical excellence, and collaboration across the engineering and construction sectors.


That investment matters because delivering complex national security programs takes more than technical capability. It takes strong relationships across government and industry, a pipeline of engineering talent, and forums where professionals share ideas and develop the next generation of leaders. SAME creates those connections around the shared goals of national security and infrastructure resilience, and our team helps strengthen that community through leadership, mentorship, professional engagement, and volunteer service.


### Building What Comes Next In Huntsville


This award is meaningful because it recognizes the collective impact of our people, not a single program or accomplishment. Proximity alone doesn’t build lasting partnerships. Consistently showing up, contributing expertise, investing in people, and engaging in the professional community around the mission does.


As our Huntsville work evolves, we’ll keep investing in both: delivering the capabilities and infrastructure our customers need and strengthening the engineering community that makes those missions possible.


Congratulations and thank you to our Huntsville employees who represent Parsons every day through their work, leadership, mentorship, and service. This recognition belongs to all of you.
